review_type: fresh independent targeted source, actual-render and interaction review
verdict: Material software parity gaps remain. Not 10/10.

scores.scale: Qualitative exact-C#-parity judgments, not completion percentages. Overall gives equal weight to UI/UX and features.

rationale: Run 14 closes the retained PLAN coordinate-system gap (round-13 priority 4, medium). The GEO/UTM/MGRS selector sits where coords1 sits in panel4: the combo at (3,5) 64 px wide, text at combo.Right+3, AltSource below the combo, and in MGRS mode the MGRS line below the combo with the source to its right, as Coords.OnPaint lays them out. The selection persists as Settings 'fpcoordmouse'. The Commands grid has Zone/Easting/Northing/MGRS between Frame and Delete, with the resx widths 57/67/72/64. Visibility toggles exactly as coords1_SystemChanged does. Cell edits go through convertFromUTM/convertFromMGRS semantics: signed PointLatLngAlt zone, 0,0 easting/northing rejected, MGRS results with a zero lat or lng rejected, parse failures ignored. The GeoUtility port follows WGSUTM (Norway/Svalbard zones, band, Math.Round to 3 places), UTM.ToString with .NET Framework double formatting, MGRS.TryParse and MGRS.Format. The round-14 renders show both modes. All residuals are low. The grid uses GeoUtility series where the original grid uses ProjNet (PointLatLngAlt.ToUTM, utmpos.ToLLA), so values can differ at millimetre level. The mouse readout does not follow the map centre on pan (MainMap_OnCurrentPositionChanged), and the UTM capture shows 0,0 ('31N 166021.445 0') where the original would show the centre. Escape commits a coordinate edit instead of cancelling it. Typed zone text is re-normalised. The Ocean altitude source is missing. Every other retained gap is unchanged in source. They include several high-severity feature areas: video, swarm, plugins and transports/mobile. They also include the full httpserver service, display flags, localization and Rover direct-write feedback. The closure earns credit on both axes but does not move the score far.

run14_dispositions.change: PLAN Coords selector (GEO/UTM/MGRS) with SRTM altitude/source and fpcoordmouse persistence
run14_dispositions.closed_parts: The combo offers GEO/UTM/MGRS in enum order and saves Settings 'fpcoordmouse'. An unknown saved value falls back to GEO. Layout follows Coords with Vertical=true at panel4 (3,3). GEO shows lat/lng to 7 decimals plus alt '0.00'+unit, with AltSource below the combo. UTM splits UTM.ToString on spaces into zone+band, east and north lines plus alt. MGRS draws below the combo, with the source at combo.Right+4. UTM and MGRS skip drawing outside lat -80..84 / lng (-180,180), as Coords.OnPaint returns early there. Altitude is SRTM through units::alt, with source 'SRTM' or 'Invalid'.
run14_dispositions.remaining: The original also sets coords1 Lat/Lng to the map centre whenever the map position changes (MainMap_OnCurrentPositionChanged), so it shows the centre before any mouse move and while panning. The port only tracks the mouse, which is why the UTM capture shows 0,0. There is no 'Ocean' or 'ASCII' altsource. The setting is written on change rather than on form close, which makes no practical difference.

run14_dispositions.change: Commands grid Zone/Easting/Northing/MGRS columns, visibility and editable conversion
run14_dispositions.closed_parts: The column order matches Designer AddRange: Frame, coordZone, coordEasting, coordNorthing, MGRS, Delete. The widths match resx (57/67/72/64). column_visible reproduces coords1_SystemChanged for all three systems. Cells derive from lat/lng as convertFromGeographic does: signed GetUTMZone zone, easting/northing to '0.000', GeoUtility MGRS string, blank at 0,0. Ending an edit converts back through utmpos (signed zone) or MGRS, ignores 0,0 easting/northing and MGRS results with a zero lat or lng, and ignores parse failures. That matches the catch-and-return paths. Clicking a coordinate cell selects the row.
run14_dispositions.remaining: The original grid uses ProjNet transforms (PointLatLngAlt.ToUTM via TryGetTransform, utmpos.ToLLA). The port uses GeoUtility series for both, so the third decimal can differ, more so far from the central meridian or in a forced zone. The original keeps typed cell text after an edit. The port re-derives it, so a typed zone such as 56 becomes the computed zone. An Escape key press commits the edit, whereas DataGridView cancels. The original's thousands-separator tolerance in double.Parse is absent. MGRS cell text renders slightly high in the cell.

run14_dispositions.change: mp-core GeoUtility port (WGSUTM, UTMWGS, UTMMGR, MGRUTM, MGRS TryParse/Format)
run14_dispositions.closed_parts: The zone formula, the Norway (32V) and Svalbard (31/33/35/37X) exceptions, the band lookup and the Math.Round(…,3) banker's rounding match WGSUTM. UTM.ToString uses .NET Framework 15-significant-digit double text. MGRS.TryParse strips spaces, uppercases, takes a 1- or 2-digit zone, rejects band I/O outside C..X and grid letters I/O/Z, requires an even digit count, and truncates or pads to 5 digits. MGRS.Format pads to 5 and strips shared trailing zeros, so '6W' has no leading zero. The tests cross-check against independent PyPI utm values within 1 cm. Enter UTM Coord now also uses the GeoUtility inverse, as the original UTM->Geographic does.
run14_dispositions.remaining: Coverage is source review plus unit tests. No C# runtime was run side by side.

run14_dispositions.change: egui interaction test for system switching and coordinate edits
run14_dispositions.closed_parts: The test drives the real action_panel and commands_grid through raw input. It switches GEO->UTM->MGRS->GEO and asserts the persisted setting and the visible headers each time. It edits Easting and checks the lat/lng round trip, types a non-numeric Northing and checks the position is unchanged, and edits MGRS and checks the result.
run14_dispositions.remaining: Zone edits, southern/northern sign flips, Escape and a settings reload at startup are untested.

new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.title: Provide the rest of the original embedded HTTP/websocket service
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.finding: Unchanged at 4f003f4. kml_server binds 127.0.0.1 on first click and answers only network/location/wps/model, with 404 for everything else. The original serves the MJPEG HUD/map streams, MAVLink websockets, Mavelous, guided/command_long/rcoverride/get_mission APIs, hud.html, georef KML and an index from startup on all interfaces.
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.next_fix: Start the service at launch on the original binding. Add the streams, the websocket bridge, the HTTP APIs, hud.html, georef KML and the index. Verify each endpoint with HTTP and websocket client tests against the simulator.

new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.title: Report failed direct writes and match the numeric write timing
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.finding: Unchanged. ParamSet{ok:false} from a direct write is ignored, so no 'Set X Failed!' message appears. There is no 300 ms coalescing and no optimistic display.
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.next_fix: Track direct writes, raise the original error on failure, add 300 ms numeric coalescing, and test both rejection and a combo write.

new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.title: Follow the map centre in the Coords readout and match grid edit semantics
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.finding: New residual from the run-14 closure. coords1 is also driven by MainMap_OnCurrentPositionChanged, which shows the centre at load and while panning. The port shows 0,0 until the mouse moves. Grid UTM uses GeoUtility instead of ProjNet. Escape commits instead of cancelling. Typed zone text is re-normalised. The Ocean/ASCII altitude sources are absent.
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.next_fix: Update the readout position on map-centre changes, use a full-accuracy TM (Krüger/ProjNet-equivalent) for the grid, cancel on Escape, and add the Ocean source.

new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.title: Match server lifetime and binding
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.finding: Unchanged. The server starts on click and binds loopback only.
new_or_remaining_affected_gaps.next_fix: Fold this into the startup HTTP service.
